name: dsh-compat-diagnostics-ui
description: Diagnostics host routes: displays one dsh-compat-diagnose envelope, a live conflict report, and repair preview/apply through dsh-compat-repair. One write path exists: repair-apply writes one allow-listed document inside the configured repair root, is off unless repair.applyEnabled is true, and needs an approval file in the configured approvalsDir (trusted as far as whoever can write that directory; approver is a label, not authentication).
